aggregation: per-feature median of nested sampled bouts
eligibility: at least 5 valid bouts of each band on the same day, valid target
sampling: one uniformly hash-selected eligible day per person-visit, five hash-ranked bouts per band; independent of clinical scores

draws.0: all fitting, tuning, and primary OOF evaluation
draws.1: additional held-out input draw; no retraining, no prediction averaging
draws.2: additional held-out input draw; no retraining, no prediction averaging

outer: fixed cohort-stratified person 5-fold CV, all visits grouped
inner: cohort-stratified person 3-fold CV within each outer training set
weights: each person has equal total training weight; each person has equal metric weight
interpretation: exploratory sensor-feature prediction; no video or independent external validation
